title: Direction contract v1.2 — shared definitions
description: IDs, anchors, state assertions, invariants and enums shared by artifacts 40–46. Assertions are evaluated against the existing model state signature (lib/direction_contract/contract.py: model_state_signature) obtained by replaying the compiled visual_timeline — no pixels involved.

scene_id.description: Director scene id, e.g. SC009. Production scene ids (scene_plan) are a separate namespace.

qualified_id.description: Scene-qualified id of an anchor, beat, state, object, action, event, invariant or causal chain: <scene_id>/<local id>, e.g. SC009/A02. Canonical everywhere downstream.

fingerprint.description: contract_fingerprint(): sha256 over canonical JSON of {contract: 40 without its lifecycle block, pvm: 41}.

contract_ref.description: Every downstream artifact names the exact contract it consumed. Identity is artifact + revision + fingerprint, never a file name.

anchor.description: Authority reference into the approved script. exact_text is the script text after Unicode NFC + whitespace normalization, verbatim otherwise. Fuzzy matching is allowed only later, in alignment (visual_timeline.anchor_resolution); the contract is never rewritten with a fuzzy result.

script_span_id.description: Stable span id of the script artifact, when it has them.

occurrence_index.description: Which occurrence of exact_text in the normalized script (0 = first).

edge.description: The time the anchor names: where the words start or where they end.

assertion.description: A check on the model state signature. 'path' is dot-separated into the signature: elements.<id>.visible, elements.<id>.attrs.<attr>, measures, active, view.<key> (element models); timeline_rail signatures use their own keys. An aggregate assertion combines several numeric paths.

numeric_target.description: One numeric path, or the aggregate of several (e.g. the sum of all allocation edges).

freedom.description: Implementation decisions a worker may take without a deviation. Never grantable in a REQUIRED_LOCKED scene: causal order, action removal, action merge, state removal, narration anchor change (see NEVER_FREE in the README).
